sharedboardImagine.designSummary: Inferred the contact page from the selected wireframe and the finished NORTH / STUDIO index reference; both optional direction fields were empty. Retained the original 1000 by 760 page at x=1140, y=0, the same header, the Contact me heading, stacked Name / Email / Message form, send action, and right-hand Contact details area. Reused the reference's exact cream #f6f4ee, forest #244b3e, muted green #6d7f72, sage #dfe7d5 and white palette; font family 2 throughout with 48px page title, 26px card heading, 18px introduction, and 15–16px form text. Header placement follows the reference, with a discreet underline for the current Contact page. A 62px content inset, 450px form column, 88px gutter, consistent 54px white inputs, and 48px forest action establish reusable components. The sage enquiry card mirrors the reference's rounded visual panel and includes neutral project-enquiry copy without inventing an email address, telephone number, office location or response promise. All content is editable canvas text and primitive shapes; reference elements are excluded from the replacement.
